schema.target: what it gates access to / what results
schema.factStatus: FACT | INFERENCE | RECOMMENDATION -- NEVER merged, exactly one per entry

entries.stage: Event entry gated by reset count
entries.requirement: Character's reset count must fall within a configured [ResetMin, ResetMax] range (or the check is disabled entirely when both are -1)
entries.target: Ability to join Blood Castle, Chaos Castle, Devil Square, or Illusion Temple
entries.notes: FACT tier because the mechanism itself (the engine checks ResetMin/ResetMax at join time) is demonstrated directly and unambiguously on video, not inferred or recommended. What is NOT yet FACT for Blood Moon specifically: whether Blood Moon sets any non-default (-1/-1) values on any of the 4 affected events -- that would require reading the real per-event config (not yet located, see CLAIM-035's verificationTargets) or the corresponding Data/EventItemBag/012-026 files. Until then this entry describes what the ENGINE supports, not what BLOOD MOON has configured -- keep those two questions separate.

entries.requirement: Character level >= 400 (vendor's suggested threshold, not a hard-coded engine limit)
entries.target: Access to a purpose-built 'build points' farming map, using CustomMonster.txt's RewardPoints column on specifically-configured monsters
entries.rewardOrBenefit: Accumulation of a custom 'points' currency (distinct from level/XP) via repeated monster kills, typically combined with open PvP on the same map for kill competition
entries.confidence: CONFIRMED_VENDOR_VIDEO (that the vendor said this) -- NOT evidence that Blood Moon itself implements or follows this pattern
entries.notes: This is the vendor's own generic advice for how server admins COULD use the RewardPoints feature, not a description of anything Blood Moon has actually built. Recorded as RECOMMENDATION tier specifically so it is never later mistaken for a FACT about Blood Moon's real progression system. CLAIM-020 (RewardPoints/RewardLevel columns exist and are real, confirmed via CustomMonster.txt) is the FACT this RECOMMENDATION is built on top of -- but the FACT only confirms the mechanism exists, not that Blood Moon uses it this way.
